_comment: MUTATION-TIERED-ROLLOUT-1. Thresholds live HERE, not in a script or a checklist (SO #41) — run-mutation-tier.mjs and chaingraph/kernels/mutation-tier-split.mjs read this file, never hardcode a floor. Generalizes FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1 (board/done/FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1.md, research/FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1-REPORT.md) from a 10-kernel pilot to risk-tiered estate thresholds.
moneyMathTarget_comment: The staging row's stated aspiration ('target 95%'). NOT the enforced floor today — see moneyMathBreakFloor. Ratchet-up target for future rows once broader estate data (the nightly full-estate scan) exists.
moneyMathBreakFloor_comment: CALIBRATED AGAINST REAL PILOT-10 DATA (staging row's explicit instruction), not assumed. Re-running the FV-STRYKER-PILOT-1 10 kernels with the corrected tier split (buildArtifact()/meta/TOOL_ID/TOOL_VERSION excluded from money-math, per mutation-tier-split.mjs's bracket-stack classifier — NOT a naive 'before buildArtifact()' line cut, which double-counted meta as money-math for kernels like art-431 that declare meta before compute()) measured, BEFORE any test authoring: art-06 31.2% (93/298), art-275 65.3% (314/481), art-431 78.4% (76/97), art-504 64.5% (220/341), art-505 63.6% (173/272), art-506 67.5% (334/495), art-508 61.1% (694/1135), art-509 55.3% (394/712), art-535 72.8% (190/261), art-77 59.3% (108/182). Weighted average (killed/total across all 10) = 60.7%. 95% is not reachable today without touching sealed/frozen proptest assumptions on every one of the 10 in one row — most of the pilot sits in a 55-78% band, nowhere near 95. Floor calibrated to 60 (nearest round number at/just below the measured weighted average) so it is a REAL, non-trivial bar — 2 of the 10 (art-06, art-509) fail it honestly as named leads below — without requiring a rewrite of every kernel's test suite in this row. This is a ratchet-up floor (SO #41 — never lowered silently); raising it toward the 95% target is future-row work once the nightly full-estate scan has enough cycles to know what's broadly holdable, not just across these 10.
peripheralBreakFloor_comment: Holdable floor per staging note. Measured pilot-10 peripheral (buildArtifact()/meta/TOOL_ID/TOOL_VERSION) score was 0% across every one of the 10, before and after this row's fix — proptest floors import ONLY `compute` (scripts/run-proptests.mjs's own soundness comment), so this code is structurally unexercised by design, not from neglect. See 'peripheralGateMode' below: measured and reported on every run, but does not fail the gate until dedicated buildArtifact()/meta coverage exists (a separate, out-of-fence follow-up — the row's own scope-discipline clause says 'note the question, do not solve it').
peripheralGateMode_comment: advisory | enforced. While advisory, a peripheral-tier score below peripheralBreakFloor is printed and included in every summary but does NOT fail run-mutation-tier.mjs's exit code. Flip to 'enforced' once buildArtifact()/meta gets its own dedicated test coverage. MUTATION-DECOMPOSED-SCORE-1 (2026-08-29) fixed this file's consumer: a NULL peripheral score (the checker could not run) is now a distinct non-pass state, never a PASS (SO #34c) — it gates in enforced mode and is printed as non-pass in advisory mode.
decomposedGateMode_comment: MUTATION-DECOMPOSED-SCORE-1 (2026-08-29): advisory | enforced. While advisory, --decomposed runs measure and report fixtureKills/propertyKills but never gate the exit code, and the as-shipped blended floors gate exactly as before this row (the transition is STATED, not silent: the blend keeps gating as the existing floor until a future row changes it). Flipping to 'enforced' ADDS the propertyKills gate below on top of the existing floors — floors only tighten (SO #41 ratchet); the gate decision itself reads ONLY propertyKills, never the blended sum (decomposedGateDecision in run-mutation-tier.mjs).
propertyKillsBreakFloor_comment: MUTATION-DECOMPOSED-SCORE-1 (2026-08-29): break floor on the money-math tier's PROPERTY kills (kills that survive the audit EXP-D fixture-leg neutralization), as a percentage of the tier's total mutants. Starts at 0 by design — the row's stated transition shape is a propertyKills floor that begins non-gating and ratchets up from MEASURED estate data in future rows, never from the blended sum (the blend is what let 0/110 property-content kills read as 53.64%). Measured decomposed basis at staging (6 kernels, origin/main 80a5a112, 2026-08-29): art-223 69.4% property / 21.1% fixture-leg; art-11 34.1% / 47.0%; art-431 50.5% / 35.5%; art-77 20.3% / 75.0%; art-524 49.7% / 32.0%; art-618 34.2% / no fixture leg. A future ratchet must clear the measured property-only distribution, not the blended one.
kernelTimeoutSeconds_comment: MUTATION-TIER-CONFIG-BOUND-1 (SO #41: thresholds live in config): per-kernel wall-clock bound consumed by run-mutation-tier.mjs, resolved env MUTATION_TIER_KERNEL_TIMEOUT_S > kernelTimeoutSeconds[id] > default 600 s; a present value must be a positive integer number of seconds or the run fails loudly naming the kernel and the bad value. pnr-01-dora-ict-cascade-simulator = 9000, justified by the PNR01-MUTATION-MC-COST-1 row's stated bound: pnr-01 measured GREEN at 4559680 ms = 76 min (push log archived in PR #1895's tier-evidence comment) — a bound the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically (required CI run 34873463221 failed 'MUTATION-TIER TIMEOUT pnr-01-dora-ict-cascade-simulator after 600s' twice), and 9000 s is that row's stated-bound ceiling (the finisher's ~98 min named-lead projection stays inside it). rca-02-mica-reserve-stress = 4000, justified by MUTATION-TIER-PERCENTILE-BOUNDS-1 from rca-02's OWN recorded measurement (2026-08-31, RCA02-RESERVE-TAIL-1 fix branch: Stryker 8.7.1, 1380 mutants, 31m24s = 1884 s wall at concurrency 2 — the same measurement its namedLeads entry above quotes; deliberately NOT re-measured) — 4000 s is ~2.1x that recorded wall, the same ~2x-headroom shape as pnr-01's 9000-over-4560, while the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically. mms-03-app-fraud-graph = 12000, justified by MUTATION-TIER-PERCENTILE-BOUNDS-1's own detached full measurement (2026-09-14/15, origin/main dad743e1: completed end-to-end at runtimeMs 5548011 = 5548 s = 1h32m28s wall at concurrency 2, 0 hard fails, exit 1 = the measured below-floor floor-fail its namedLeads entry documents; log + summary JSON quoted in PR #1903) — 12000 s is ~2.2x that measured wall; the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically (the exact MUTATION-TIER-HANG-MMS03-PNR01-1 shape). sim-01-lcr-nsfr-liquidity-stress-test = 30000, justified by MUTATION-TIER-SIM01-ENTRY-1's own detached full measurement (2026-09-15, origin/main f49c242d: completed end-to-end with 0 hard fails at runtimeMs 14699570 = 14699.6 s = 4h04m59.57s wall at concurrency 2, exit 1 = the measured below-floor floor-fail its namedLeads entry documents; log + summary JSON quoted in this row's PR) — this supersedes the BOUNDS row's sampled 15753 s projection that had STOPped at its 4 h ceiling; 30000 s is ~2.04x that measured wall, the same ~2x-headroom shape as pnr-01's 9000-over-4560 and mms-03's 12000-over-5548, while the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically (the exact MUTATION-TIER-HANG-MMS03-PNR01-1 shape). art-616-mla-mapr-actuarial-recompute = 6000, justified by the ART616 re-sync row's own detached full measurement (2026-09-18, ART616-NUMPAY-CAP-1 rebased onto origin/main a98c547d: Stryker 8.7.1, 462 mutants, 49m17s = 2959.5 s wall at concurrency 2, money-math 67.3% (298/443) PASS over the 60 floor, peripheral 0/19 advisory per peripheralGateMode, 0 hard fails, exit 0 — log quoted in PR #1646's re-sync report) — 6000 s is ~2.03x that measured wall, the same ~2x-headroom shape as pnr-01's 9000-over-4560 and mms-03's 12000-over-5548, while the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically on CI (required run 35287528794 shard 0/6 failed 'MUTATION-TIER TIMEOUT art-616-mla-mapr-actuarial-recompute after 600s'), the exact MUTATION-TIER-HANG-MMS03-PNR01-1 shape. art-700-authorization-payload-linter = 1300, justified by the AUTH-PAYLOAD-LINTER-1 continuation row's own measured runs (2026-09-29, branch tip 104eb45b: Stryker 8.7.1, 2054 mutants at concurrency 2; the FIRST tier run hard-failed 'MUTATION-TIER TIMEOUT art-700-authorization-payload-linter after 601s' because the full-trial floor costs ~1.07 s per mutant and 2054 x 1.07 s / 2 runners exceeds 600 s before a single score is possible; after the row's documented mutation-mode trial cap (PROPFLOOR_TRIAL_CAP seam, pnr-01 shape, fixture oracle never capped) the completed run measures 417.4 s wall, money-math 68.3% (1389/2034) PASS over the 60 floor, peripheral 0/20 advisory per peripheralGateMode, 0 hard fails, exit 0) — 1300 s is ~3.1x that measured wall, a deliberately wider headroom than the family's ~2x because the kernel sits 8.3 points above its floor and an affordable re-run matters more than a tight bound; the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically at ~1.44x the measured wall, the exact MUTATION-TIER-HANG-MMS03-PNR01-1 shape. art-703-mandate-authorization-gate = 20000, justified by HOOKSKIP-SHARD-FLOOR-GAP-1 (2026-10-11): with the hookSkipKernels deferral scoped to the in-hook leg only, this kernel now RUNS in the CI tier shards and the nightly sweep, where no MUTATION_TIER_KERNEL_TIMEOUT_S env cap applies — its prior full-verdict runs are measured in the 2h33m class (≈9180 s, per its own hookSkipKernels cause string, quoting the #2354-era measurements), so 20000 s is ~2.18x that measured wall, the same ~2x-headroom shape as rca-02's 4000-over-1884 and mms-03's 12000-over-5548, while the 600 s default hard-times-out deterministically (the exact MUTATION-TIER-HANG-MMS03-PNR01-1 shape). art-705-bond-ladder-builder = 6000, justified by the same row: its own detached full measurement (2026-10-11, ART705-BOND-LADDER-1 attempt-3 branch: completed run at 2934.4 s wall at concurrency 2, money-math 79.9% (275/344) PASS over the 60 floor, per its hookSkipKernels cause string) — 6000 s is ~2.04x that measured wall, byte-for-byte the art-616 shape (2959.5 s measured → 6000 s).Every other kernel keeps the default until its own row states otherwise. MUTATION-RATCHET-GREEN-1 (2026-10-26/27): the 10-26 nightly (run 40357657270, 20/20 shards) MEASUREMENT-LOST 28 pinned kernels — 27 as MUTATION-TIER TIMEOUT after the default 600 s (art-458-attribute-sampling-plan, the 28th, hard-failed as stryker-produced-no-report at ~302 s: NOT a timeout, not bound-curable, needs its own defect row) — and every one of the 27 was measured locally on the row branch (node scripts/run-mutation-tier.mjs --kernel <id> --concurrency 3, env MUTATION_TIER_KERNEL_TIMEOUT_S=1500 so the reading is a true wall, not a 600 s truncation; walls quoted in the row PR). Each entry is min(2x measured local wall, 1500 s) per the row brief: art-662-odnsf-fee-recompute measured 316 s -> 632; art-02-agent-spend-policy-simulator measured 543 s -> 1086; the other 25 measured 758-1411 s (2x exceeds the row 1500 s ceiling) -> 1500. CI/local headroom note: the same kernels measured >600 s on the 4-core CI runners while several measured 316-543 s locally, so CI walls run up to ~2x local; the 1500 s entries carry >=1.06x headroom over the measured local wall and the next nightly is the row owed verdict on whether that holds. STRICT-SOLO AMENDMENT (same row, after the pair runs): five of the 27 were re-measured STRICTLY SOLO (only ambient load shared): art-330 (981 s), art-189 (1411 s), art-652 (962 s), art-280 (1319 s) and qfa-04 (1274 s, pair) completed under 1500 s and keep their 1500 s entries; the remainder — art-201-iscc-content-code-generator, ml-03-timeseries-anomaly-detector, art-279-state-proof-verifier, qfa-02-portfolio-var-engine, art-583-beacon-seeded-fair-sampling-deriver — still hit the 1500 s cap strictly solo (MUTATION-TIER TIMEOUT kill, no report), which is the row brief's STOP: a hang, not a bound problem. Their entries are WITHDRAWN here (a 1500 s bound on a >=1500 s wall buys 15 extra shard-minutes per kill and cures nothing; they keep the 600 s default) and they are routed to hang rows.

excludedKernels.art-424-witness-cosignature-verifier: Stryker/babel instrumentation cannot handle the ML-DSA-44 rejection-sampling labeled loop (main_loop: for(;;) + continue main_loop, vendored noble shape, kernel lines 2729-2768): the instrumented sandbox copy fails Node parse (Illegal continue statement: main_loop does not denote an iteration statement) before any mutant runs. Tool limitation, not a test deficit — the kernel is valid JS (9/9 EXEC_OK at this row's cycle preflight, sealed zkVM receipt sha256:1a82a2ce). Only kernel in the estate with a labeled loop. First carried by PR #2772 (COSIGN-MLDSA44-V2-RESUME-1, unmerged at this row's staging); re-applied here because this row touches the kernel and keeps the vendored labeled loop.

hookSkipKernels._comment: V425 (7F-V425(1)/(3), 2026-10-10; scoped 2026-10-12 by HOOKSKIP-SHARD-FLOOR-GAP-1): kernels the pre-push hook's scoped mutation-tier leg DEFERS instead of running (measured: cannot finish inside any bound a pre-push hook should hold). The deferral is IN-HOOK-ONLY: .githooks/pre-push marks its preflight invocation with MUTATION_TIER_IN_HOOK=1 and run-mutation-tier.mjs applies this list ONLY when that marker is present — every CI context (the six PR scripts-verify-tier-shard shards and the nightly --all sweep) RUNS these kernels under their kernelTimeoutSeconds bounds and floors them, so the floor is carried, never dropped.
